defects.source_says: EO 12201 (45 FR 17123, signed March 14, 1980) was issued before EO 12225 (July 3, 1980) and does not cite it; the citation runs from EO 12225 to EO 12201. reasoning: The genuine claim's dates are correct and match the held text: 1-101 and 1-104 are amendments performed on their stated effective date, 1980-07-28; 1-103 is a revocation as of 1980-07-28; 1-102 is a revocation as of 1980-08-11; 1-105 has no stated date and was performed on signing, 1980-07-03. The whole-order end of 1980-08-11 is the latest clause end. Identity, inventory, quotations and savings are correct. The research rationale, however, states twice that EO 12201 cites this order. That is false: EO 12201 is the earlier order and the one being amended. Because the earlier-end check rests on this misdescribed search result, the claim fails the rule that every fact in the rationale must match the sources. Correcting that sentence to say that no held text other than this order's own text cites it by number would make the claim upholdable. This is the same citation-direction defect found in blind review.
